levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد بن عمران الدقاق

notes: «بإسناده رفع الحديث» is a gap: Kulayni's own isnad is not written, so an unnamed link stands in its place (rule 8)
the Imam «كلمه أبو عبد الله» speaks inside the story and is the last link (owner ruling 5)
Ibn Abi al-Awja is in the scene only and is not a link
the report is long; the matn is read as the text stands
